title: Choose a workshop label system
question: Which label system best fits our small workshop's budget and planning horizon?
background: Entirely fictional sample. These values are arithmetic fixtures, not supplier quotes or market estimates.
goal: Replace handwritten labels with a repeatable label system for workshop orders.

options.label: Option A · lower upfront
consequences: Lower initial commitment; monthly costs accumulate faster.

options.label: Option B · lower recurring
consequences: Higher initial commitment; lower recurring cost.

options.label: Keep handwritten labels
consequences: Reversible and avoids a purchase; does not meet the stated replacement goal.

hard_requirements.description: All-in cost must remain within USD 2,500 over the chosen horizon.
Replace handwritten labels with a repeatable label system.
Spend at least 1200 on the selected approach

preferences.description: Prefer the lower comparable cost after hard requirements are met.
Prefer a smaller initial commitment when costs are otherwise comparable.

user_facts: Fictional scenario: both purchased systems meet the stated workflow need.
Tax, delivery, maintenance and installation are explicitly included at zero additional cost in the complete fictional quotes.
Keeping the current workflow is feasible but does not achieve the replacement goal.
